MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #18
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. They are equal
   C. Cannot tell
   D. 2/2

2. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 34
   B. 22
   C. 17
   D. 66

3. What is √81? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 10
   C. 40.5
   D. 81

4. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. 1/4
   C. 2/3
   D. 3/4

5. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 11
   C. 24
   D. 5

6. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27
   B. 27.6
   C. 33
   D. 27.7

7. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 30
   C. 21
   D. 42

8. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 40
   C. 400
   D. 10

9. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.7
   B. 15.6
   C. 21
   D. 15

10. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 56
   C. 57
   D. 15

11. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 29
   B. 23.6
   C. 23
   D. 23.7

12. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 22
   C. 122
   D. 121

13. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 36
   C. 12
   D. 42

14. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 18
   C. 81
   D. 36

15. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 7 cm and 24 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 17
   C. 27
   D. 31

16. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 10
   C. 400
   D. 40

17. Solve for x: x + 6 = 10. (1 mark)
   A. 6
   B. 4
   C. 10
   D. 5

18. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 144
   C. 156
   D. 24

19. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 24
   C. 2
   D. 25

20. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x
   B. 12x + 2
   C. 12x
   D. 6x + 2

21. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 12 cm³
   B. 27 cm³
   C. 9 cm³
   D. 18 cm³

22. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 26
   C. 10
   D. 25

23. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 31.6
   C. 31
   D. 31.7

24. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 169
   C. 13
   D. 170

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
25. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

26. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

27. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

29. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

30. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

31. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
